links.outcome: Hallucinations and inaccuracies per LLM-generated summary in the deployed EHR interface
links.effect: Estimated 0.73 hallucinations and 1.60 inaccuracies per generation for summaries, the most frequent UI task.
links.quote: Generation of summaries was the most frequent task in the UI, with an estimated 0.73 hallucinations and 1.60 inaccuracies per generation.

links.outcome: Adequacy of benchmark-based evaluation for monitoring the deployed LLM interface
links.effect: Benchmark-based evaluations were insufficient for monitoring and evaluating the UI, so new monitoring methods were required.
links.quote: Benchmark-based evaluations proved insufficient for monitoring and evaluation of the UI, requiring new methods to monitor performance.

unlisted_practices: Value assessment framework to prioritize LLM use cases and quantify cost, time and revenue impact
Building an internally governed, vendor-agnostic LLM platform (build-from-within)
Model-agnostic selection of LLMs matched to specific clinical or administrative tasks

screen.reason: Empirical study describing the real-world organizational deployment, adoption, and monitoring of an institutional LLM platform (ChatEHR) across clinical and administrative workflows, but does not isolate/test a specific deployment safeguard with a comparative design.
